method: differential analysis of our own scripted rollouts from the verified start state, cross-checked against the profile's own verified ram_mapping; no external RAM maps or disassembly
genre: non-linear Metroidvania (hard exploration); no single monotone axis; item/missile/energy-tank/boss state lives in cartridge PRG-RAM ($6000-$7FFF) that get_ram masks off, so this is a COVERAGE baseline over (area, x, y)

step1_ingameplay.test: right-40f vs left-40f byte divergence from the start state
step1_ingameplay.note: inputs move Samus (135 bytes differ) -> live gameplay, not the input-ignoring title-screen demo

progress.semantics: 0x0050 = coarse scroll-column counter (x-on-map); 0x0051 = fine on-screen X (0-255)
progress.wrap_reversibility_test: flat under NOOP; rises hold-right (768->1500), falls hold-left (->~512); combined signal 99% monotone non-decreasing under hold-right (prog_monotone_nondec_frac 0.99)

saturation_test.x_screen_0x0051_alone: CAMERA-CLAMPS at 220 (on-screen X pins at the right screen edge while the world scrolls) -> REJECTED as sole progress
saturation_test.x_map_0x0050: non-saturating scroll-column counter, steps 3->4->5 across screens of rightward travel -> the room/screen counter the lore prescribes pairing the camera byte with
saturation_test.combined_under_dumb_holds: caps at 1500 under hold-right AND mixed right+jump for 1200f because the START ROOM is physically bounded (scripted holds cannot reach the exit door) -- a room boundary, NOT a camera clamp on the combined signal
saturation_test.conclusion: paired (coarse-column<<8 | fine-X) is the honest forward-travel spine; the search, not dumb holds, breaks past 1500 -- confirmed in step5 (Go-Explore reached 2191)

y.test: spans 5 distinct 32-px bands (0,3,4,5,6) across 2000f of varied movement -> usable fine vertical coverage axis
y.rejected_alternative: 0x004F (y-on-map) stayed constant (14) through jump + 2000f random movement -- too static/coarse in the reachable region, and //Y_BAND(32) would collapse a small map-row range to a single band

area.test: constant 0 through all scripted probes and the 4.5-min solve (regions change only at far major transitions); leads the cell key / frontier so a future region reach steps it

energy_death.semantics: energy tens digit + filled-tank nibble (verified ram_mapping); start = 3 (30 energy: 0x0107*10 + 0x0106 = 30)
energy_death.death_proxy: HP-decrease: a DECREASE of 0x0107 means Samus lost >=10 energy or a tank = took a real hit; the lineage is terminated. Coarse by design (chip damage below a tens boundary does not reset). Metroid has no system-RAM lives counter and no clean death-state byte, so this is the honest death signal.

level_key.reason: no reachable per-level clear byte (item/missile/energy-tank/boss state is unreachable PRG-RAM) -> coverage baseline

step2_discovery.scan_scope: full 2KB system RAM ($0000-$07FF), not just zero-page

step5_solve.solutions_note: 0 is expected -- level_key empty (coverage baseline, no clear condition)
step5_solve.key_finding: Go-Explore reached progress 2191, well past the 1500 ceiling that all scripted dumb holds cap at -- the search found start-room-exit maneuvers dumb holds cannot complete

step5_random_baseline.description: identical per-step action distribution (solver right/jump weights + sticky 0.5) and the SAME cell_fn, but NO archive return-to-frontier (each worker runs from root, resets to root on death/max_steps); matched step budget

step5_validation_go_explore_vs_random.verdict: Go-Explore OUT-TRAVELS random: 5.8x more distinct coverage cells at equal step budget and a higher position frontier. The return-to-frontier archive is the differentiator on this hard-exploration game.

step6_observatory_v2.interpretation: top candidates cluster in the OAM shadow / object-state region ($0200-$04FF) -- sprite/enemy/projectile positions correlated with the aim-up probe. $0082 (zero-page, adjacent to the player X-subpixel bytes $0081) is the most interesting non-OAM candidate for a future state_sig refinement. None is required for the coverage baseline; each still needs the verify-then-add process before entering the profile.

purity: every number above is from a run executed here; all addresses from our own rollouts + the profile's own verified ram_mapping; no external maps/disassembly
